style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

⟦0⟧ starts out in a peculiar position, and the one thing that will guarantee your survival is fortifying the Sudetenland. Using the Sudetenland Fortifications focuses, you will have level 7 land forts along the German border and it continues through the Sudetenland to Bratislava. The Czech Entente focuses get you some backing, and you get Yugoslavia and Romania on your side. Having the two biggest armies in the Balkans on your side is crucial to your survival as Czechoslovakia. Or, hope the French go down the Little Entente path and invite you to the Little Entente, but this is much more likely when you have Historical AI Focus off. Keep note that you don't need Historical AI focus to get Czechmate or The Munich Disagreement. Then wait around and build up your army until the Germans come in, and the Wehrmacht has to take in the fact that the Sudetenland is mountainous and going into the Sudetenland forts would be a suicide mission! While waiting for the Germans to invade, hope that France and Britain back you and build up forts in Bohemia and Moravia. If time allows, go ahead and build forts on the Polish and Hungarian borders. When the Germans make an invasion attempt of Czechoslovakia (if they do), those forts are going to help you out. With those forts backing up the Germans and your allies keeping the German invasion of Czechoslovakia weaker, go for Munich and you will get The Munich Disagreement achievement. Continue through Germany with as many divisions as you can, get the Germans to capitulate (nukes do not help with captitulation, they just kill more people) and when the treaty comes, ⟦1⟧
take as much land as you can.

Acquiring the new territory will provide access to the sea, stimulate industrial growth, and expand the labor force. Furthermore, it will eliminate the risk of invasion from the west. It is now recommended that you proceed with the occupation of Hungary. At this juncture, it would be prudent to surround Hungary with your allies in order to facilitate an invasion. It is recommended that all divisions be deployed to the fronts, that allies be engaged in the conflict, and that the objective of Budapest be pursued. It is anticipated that Pecs and Debrecen will be captured along the way. In the event that Italy offers its support, it would be prudent to consider launching an invasion in that region as well. Should one wish to truly achieve a state of "Czechmate," it would be prudent to first allow global tensions to intensify (in the event that one is a democratic leader), provide justification for military action against the United Kingdom, and then commence hostilities. A joint naval invasion of England from northern France is also a viable option. Following this, the naval forces can be used to invade Egypt or, if Libya is also under control, the Suez Canal. Gibraltar can then be secured, and the Mediterranean can be dominated by capturing Malta and Cyprus. Finally, the Raj and East Africa can be invaded. However, the primary objective should be to focus the naval forces on reaching Western Australia. By establishing a foothold in the vicinity of Perth, the player can claim the achievement "Czechmate." Subsequently, the remainder of Australia should be occupied, with no concern for Canada. It is recommended that an invasion be avoided unless there is a clear intention to do so. Subsequently, it is recommended that as much of the British Empire as possible be seized, which will inevitably result in confrontation with the Soviet Union. It is, however, recommended that the attack be carried out with caution, as it may prove to be a suicide mission. It is therefore necessary to produce as much equipment as possible in order to face the British Empire.
